descriptions.preferred: 'Omure yama' is an excellent example of the cascading or weeping type of cultivar. As the plant attains the height of a tall shrub or small tree, the pendulous branches become willowy and form a long curtain around the perimeter. This habit is not to be confused with the cascading form of the Dissectum Group which is always a low, spreading shrub. The leaf consists of seven long, slender lobes which are held closely together. It is 7-8 cm long and 7 cm across. The leaves tend to hang down, and the closed slender lobes emphasize the pendulous effect of the branches. The lobes are lanceolate or elongate-elliptic, tapering to a slender point. They separate almost to the leaf base. The lobes are less than 1 cm wide at the lobe junctions, which makes the leaf appear open near the base. The margins are deeply toothed with fine serrations between. The long, slender petioles are 5-6 cm long. The new, unfolding foliage has a bright orange cast to the leaf edges, but the leaves soon become a uniform brilliant green. Fall colors are quite spectacular gold and crimson combinations. Young plants are vigorous and upright. Later they show the true pendulous character. rhs.description: Deciduous tree of weeping or cascading habit to 8m in height, with pendulous branches forming a curtain of leaves, each with 7 long, slender lobes hanging down, the young spring leaves are green with bright orange edges, maturing to bright green in summer, then gold and red in autumn. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适用于建筑感景观、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶小乔木，树姿下垂或呈瀑布状，高可达 8 米。下垂枝条形成如帘幕般的叶层；每片叶具 7 枚细长裂片，自然下悬。春季幼叶绿色，叶缘鲜橙色，夏季成熟为亮绿色，秋季转为金色与红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，随后可能结有带翅的紫色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Omure yama' 是垂枝或下垂型品种中的优秀代表。随着植株长成高大灌木或小乔木，其下垂枝条会变得如柳枝般柔长，并在外围形成长长的帘幕状树形。这种习性不应与 Dissectum Group 的下垂型混淆，后者始终是低矮开展的灌木。叶片由 7 个细长裂片组成，彼此靠拢，叶长 7 至 8 厘米、宽约 7 厘米。叶片常自然下垂，而狭长且较为闭合的裂片进一步强化了枝条的垂枝效果。裂片呈披针形或长椭圆形，渐尖成细长尖端，分裂几乎达到叶基。裂片在连接处宽不足 1 厘米，因此叶基附近显得较为空开。叶缘具深锯齿，其间还有细密小锯齿。细长叶柄长 5 至 6 厘米。新叶展开时，叶缘带有鲜亮的橙色调，但很快转为均一而明亮的绿色。秋色极为出色，为金色与深红色的组合。幼株长势强健且较直立，之后才逐渐显现真正的下垂特性。这个枝条柔长下垂的品种也曾以

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Omureyama' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Omure yama' Exceptional Fall Color Semi-Pendulous Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Omure yama’ is a semi-pendulous upright green Japanese maple. This classic Japanese maple tree is known for its shape similar to that of a weeping cherry tree, without the invasive root system. Because of this habit, it is a favorite among gardeners and maple enthusiasts. The fall color ranges from a golden orange to red. ‘Omure yama’ is very unique in its shape for a Japanese maple and can reach 12 ft in height over time. The tree that is the main photo is in a patio container and is not the 1 gallon size. It is shown to show the overall shape of 'Omureyama'.
